sourceSentences: [0] Against engage supports, your E is basically a nightmare. Thresh walking up to grab you or your ADC? Throw E in front of him and watch him back off.
[0] He already grabbed your ADC? E him immediately so he cannot recast his hook.
[0] You have an answer to almost every hook and engage support just built into your kit.
[1] less annoying than nautilus and slightly easier to counter. silence at the feet of whatever champ he goes in on with his hook, should prevent him from pressing his R or his flay.
[1] He's just as bad as Blitzcrank in my opinion! Try to not get grabbed! The outplay potential on this guy is scary!

[1] Can be really oppressive, your only move is to put a silence under him when he goes for a hook, so that even if he lands, he can't jump on you or follow-up with E. And if he misses, then you can just punish him.
[2] Avoid her Q as she tries to heal back and focus her almost every fight. Good scaling tho
[2] No escape, easy to land hooks on while casting. Try to engage while her Equinox (E) is on cooldown.
[2] Since she relies on her own health pool to heal, try to avoid her Starcall abilitiy. When she hits an enemy champion with it, she will regain a portion of her health.
